verdict.rationale: Metronome documents bearer-token authentication, and tokens can be created and managed in the Metronome app. Nothing in the evidence shows those tokens can be limited by permissions, resources, or read/write access, so least-privilege credentials for an agent are not evidenced. Plain token creation is an adjacent capability, not scoped credentials.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can issue scoped/least-privilege API credentials for an agent
